questions.text:
Consider the weighted undirected graph with 4 vertices,where the weigh to edge {i, j} is given by the entry Wij in the matrix W.
[latex]W=\begin{bmatrix} 0 & 2&8 & 5\\ 2& 0& 5 &8 \\ 8 & 5 & 0& x\\ 5&8 & x&0 \end{bmatrix}[/latex]
The largest possible integer value of x, for which at least one shortest path between some pair of vertices will contain the edge with weight x is ____.
questions.solution:
Without edge {3, 4}, the shortest path from 3 to 4 is 3-2-1-4 = 5 + 2 + 5 = 12.

The edge of weight x lies on a shortest path (at least one, possibly tied) only if [latex]x\le12[/latex]. The largest integer is 12.

Answer: 12

questions.text: Consider a carry lookahead adder for adding two n-bit integers,built using gates of fan-in at most two. The time to perform addition using this adder is
questions.solution:
Carry lookahead computes all carries from the generate/propagate signals. With gates of fan-in 2, combining n signals needs a tree of depth [latex]\log_2 n[/latex].

Answer: [latex]\Theta(\log n)[/latex]

questions.text:
Let G be a weighted connected undirected graph with distinct positive edge weights. If every edge weight is increasedby the same value ,then which of the following statements is/are TRUE?
P: Minimum spanning tree of G does not change
Q: Shortest path between any pair of vertices does not change
questions.solution:
Checking each statement:
- P: adding the same value to every edge keeps their relative order, so Kruskal picks the same edges [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] the MST does not change [latex]\text{---}[/latex] TRUE.
- Q: a path with more edges gains more. E.g. a path 1 + 1 = 2 vs a direct edge 3 becomes 11 + 11 = 22 vs 13 (adding 10) [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] shortest paths can change [latex]\text{---}[/latex] FALSE.

Answer: P only

questions.text: The worst case running times of Insertion sort, Mergesort and Quicksort, respectively, are:
questions.solution:
Checking each statement:
- Insertion sort worst case (reverse sorted): [latex]\Theta(n^2)[/latex]
- Merge sort is always [latex]\Theta(n\log n)[/latex]
- Quicksort worst case (bad pivots every time): [latex]\Theta(n^2)[/latex]

Answer: [latex]\Theta(n^2),\Theta(n\log n),\Theta(n^2)[/latex]
